_comment: Lightspeed = JKOnet*-potential (Terpin et al. 2024). First-order JKO residual ||tau * grad V_theta(y) + (y - x)||^2 on OT-coupled consecutive observed snapshots. Entropy is TRAINABLE here (init 0.05) to match the bridge/stitching method's setup; pin via freeze_entropy to recover the deterministic JKOnet*_V baseline.
